主要内容: On May 16, 2012, HENRY SCHEIN INC amended its Certificate of Incorporation to eliminate plurality voting in director elections. The change, effective after filing with Delaware’s Secretary of State, allows the By-laws to set alternative procedures. The Board also amended the By-laws to require a majority vote for non-contested director elections, with affirmative votes counted specifically for or against each nominee. Contested elections will still use plurality voting. HENRY SCHEIN INC adopted a director resignation policy aligned with the majority vote standard. Incumbent directors who fail to secure an affirmative majority of votes for re-election must tender their resignation to the Board, subject to acceptance. The Nominating and Governance Committee will recommend whether to accept or reject the resignation, and the Board will act on the tendered resignation within 90 days of the election results certification. The Board will publicly disclose its decision and rationale through a press release, SEC filing, or other communication. The resigning director will not participate in the recommendation or decision process. The policy is detailed in the attached Charter Amendment and By-law Amendment.
